_: PLACEHOLDER register. Seeded from the canon bestiary so contents.creatures[].registerRef has somewhere to point; Phase 13's creature register adds stats and spawn tables. assetAvailability records what asset can actually deliver each creature (docs/research/creature-asset-availability.md).

entries.name: Bog Blight
entries.notes: Argonian dead whose grave-stake came loose; warded off with pahnjees.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla draugr (meshes/actors/draugr) + BM&V troll/ghoul.nif re-material
assetAvailability.notes: Risen Argonian dead read as marsh-rotted draugr; draugr animation set covers walk, wade and attacks.

entries.name: Crocodile
entries.notes: Two men long and fast; attacks inside town limits at Bogmother.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) slaughterfish/character assets/mihailcrocodile.nif (+ mihailcrocodileSALT)
assetAvailability.notes: Crocodile body already built on the slaughterfish skeleton, so swim and lunge animations are solved. Extraction from Data*.rar still to do.

entries.name: Death Hopper
entries.notes: Large frog; a notably large population around Gideon.

assetAvailability.via: HTBM vault pool `htbm` (meshes/here there be monsters - curse of cipactli/actors) FrogSkeleton.nif with PoisonFrogBlue/Green/Red.nif, plus Toad.nif + ToadSkeleton.nif
assetAvailability.notes: No download needed after all: the frog and toad rigs were already in the vault, hidden because the vault-inventory rigged-actor detector only looked for creature sub-folders and HTBM keeps its skeletons directly in actors/ (fixed 2026-09-04). Three colour variants give the poison/marsh reads.

entries.name: Feather-serpent
entries.notes: Said to inhabit the depths of Black Marsh; unelaborated in canon.

assetAvailability.via: no rig; deliver instead as the kaj-thux great-serpent build, BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) snakes/character assets/oldsnake.nif
assetAvailability.notes: A feathered flying serpent would need a new rig and new flight clips. The catalogue slot is re-pointed to a great serpent.

entries.name: Fellrunner
entries.notes: Its down, worked into an armband, hides a hunter in Murkwood.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) raven/raven2.nif and chicken/owl.nif family
assetAvailability.notes: Marsh bird on an existing small-bird rig; down and plumage come from the existing textures.

entries.name: Fleshfly
entries.notes: Sand-grain flesh-eating clouds; the Slough Point garrison are missing ears and noses.

assetAvailability.via: no rig; stage as a particle cloud plus damage volume
assetAvailability.notes: Sand-grain flesh-eating flies cannot be a rigged actor at any useful count. Environmental hazard, like weather.

entries.name: Giant Leech
entries.notes: Water hazard fauna.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) slaughterfish/character assets/bloodsuckerfish.nif and slaughterfish/morayeel.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Both sit on the vanilla slaughterfish skeleton; rescale for the leech read.

entries.name: Giant Wasp
entries.notes: Wasps the size of ponies.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) Chaurus Hunter/Giant Wasp/mihailgiantwasp.nif (+ skeletongiantwasp.nif)
assetAvailability.notes: Ships its own skeleton and flight set.

entries.name: Guar
entries.notes: Beast of burden; the Archon Glowgill and Gideon Ambergill are the local variants.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) guars/guar.nif, histguar.nif, ponyguar.nif, guarcharger.nif, skeleton_guarmount.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Full guar family with mount skeleton; covers the Archon Glowgill and Gideon Ambergill variants by re-material.

entries.name: Hackwing
entries.notes: Giant saw-beaked bird; strikes and returns when the traveller is failing.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) cliffracer/cliffracer.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Cliff racer is a large hostile flyer with a swoop-and-return attack, which is exactly the hackwing behaviour. Re-material for the saw beak read.

entries.name: Haj Mota
entries.notes: Large armoured swamp turtle-beast.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) cow/Glyptodon and mudcrab/character assets/stonecrab.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Armoured shell-backed grazer body on the cow rig for the walking form; stone crab as the smaller shallows variant.

entries.name: Haynekhtnamet
entries.notes: The legendary Shadowfen wamasu locals made offerings to.

assetAvailability.via: same build as creature.wamasu (HTBM Wamasu.nif/WamasuALT.nif), uniquely scaled and re-materialled
assetAvailability.notes: Follows whatever creature.wamasu resolves to.

entries.name: Hoarvor
entries.notes: Blood-drinking marsh tick.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) mudcrab/character assets/parasite.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Tick body on the mudcrab skeleton.

entries.name: Jassa Red Slug
entries.notes: Acid-secreting slug used in slug shaping.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) snail/slug.nif (+ slugskeleton.nif)
assetAvailability.notes: Ships its own crawl skeleton.

entries.name: Giant Snake (kaj-thux)
entries.notes: Ample Serpents; colossal constrictors of the interior.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) snakes/character assets/oldsnake.nif, snake.nif, snakechaurus.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Snake bodies on the chaurus skeleton; rescale hard for the colossal constrictor.

entries.name: Kotu Gava
entries.notes: Swarming marsh insect.

assetAvailability.via: no rig; stage as a particle swarm plus damage volume
assetAvailability.notes: Same as the fleshfly: an insect cloud is a hazard volume, not an actor.

entries.name: Lamia
entries.notes: Infest the caverns beneath Loriasel.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) slaughterfish/rivnaga.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Serpent-bodied humanoid; the Loriasel caverns use this build.

entries.name: Lizard-steed
entries.notes: Hist-shaped lizards in the forms of other races' mounts (wolf, senche, bear, horse, pony).

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) guars/ variants (albinoguar, tesselatedguar, striatedponyguar, palevelothiguar)
assetAvailability.notes: Hist-shaped mounts are guar variants re-materialled and rescaled to the shape they imitate.

entries.name: Marsh Giant
entries.notes: Giant woodland spirit, cousin to spriggans; the Hist urge Argonians to avoid them.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla giant (meshes/actors/giant) + BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) giant/character assets/treant.nif and AncientSpriggan/
assetAvailability.notes: Spriggan-cousin giant: treant body on the giant skeleton, ancient-spriggan materials for the plant read.

entries.name: Medusa
entries.notes: Reported in Murkwood.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) slaughterfish/rivnaga.nif
assetAvailability.notes: Same serpent-humanoid build as the lamia, differently materialled.

entries.name: Miregaunt
entries.notes: Tree-like Murkmire guardian built of plant matter and ancient architecture; comes back when struck down.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) giant/character assets/treant.nif and treantskeleton.nif
assetAvailability.notes: A walking tree of plant matter and old masonry: the treant ships its own skeleton. Xanmeer stone pieces are re-material work, not new models.

entries.name: Corimont Mouth-Plover
entries.notes: Fang-cleaning bird kept by high-status Argonians.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla chicken (meshes/actors/chicken) + BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) chicken/ bird variants
assetAvailability.notes: Small perching bird; ambient only.

entries.name: Osheeja Gar
entries.notes: Fish the Naka-Desh use to catch other fish.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla fish (meshes/actors/ambient) and slaughterfish family
assetAvailability.notes: Ordinary fish; no combat set needed.

entries.name: Rootworm
entries.notes: The Underground Express; sacred transit, never shown on screen.

assetAvailability.via: no asset by owner rule (module 90 section 78)
assetAvailability.notes: Never seen on screen. Staged from animated roots, water displacement and audio.

entries.name: Sea-drake
entries.notes: Crocodilian with paddle legs, in deep water off Lilmoth.

assetAvailability.via: HTBM vault pool `htbm` (meshes/here there be monsters - curse of cipactli/actors) SeaDrake.nif — an authored sea drake, replacing the salt-crocodile re-material
assetAvailability.notes: BM&V mihailcrocodileSALT.nif remains the fallback.

entries.name: Swamp Leviathan
entries.notes: A mountain of spines on nine-foot claws; skeletons litter Deepmire.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) gehenoth/gehenoth.nif (+ character_assets/skeleton.nif)
assetAvailability.notes: Ships its own skeleton; a mountain of a beast at the scale the lore wants.

entries.name: Voriplasm
entries.notes: A moving pool of green slime that strips a body to the bone.

assetAvailability.via: BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) snail/slug.nif (+ slugskeleton.nif), re-materialled to green slime
assetAvailability.notes: A limbless crawler is the closest honest read of a moving slime pool. Its own skeleton, so no new clips.

entries.name: Wamasu
entries.notes: Lightning-powered swamp dragon; electrifies the water around it. Bones hold a charge for years.

assetAvailability.via: HTBM vault pool `htbm` (meshes/here there be monsters - curse of cipactli/actors) Wamasu.nif and WamasuALT.nif — a purpose-authored Wamasu, replacing the earlier daedroth re-material
assetAvailability.notes: Prefer the authored model over the daedroth stand-in; the daedroth build (BM&V daedroth/daedrothfinal.nif) remains the fallback if the HTBM rig proves unusable.

entries.name: Wisp
entries.notes: Drowning-lure lights; 'shines' are the harmless cousin around Lilmoth's Imperial ruins.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla wisp and witchlight (meshes/actors/wisp, meshes/actors/witchlight)
assetAvailability.notes: Lure lights and the harmless shines are the same asset, differently tinted.

entries.name: Wispmother
entries.notes: Something intelligent behind the wisps that lure travellers to drown.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla wispmother (meshes/actors/wisp)
assetAvailability.notes: Full vanilla actor with its own set.

entries.name: Xal-Krona (Argonian Behemoth)
entries.notes: Hulking Argonian made by a Hist through sap; strong, corrosive, capable of speech.

assetAvailability.via: vanilla werewolfbeast rig + BM&V vault (tooling/asset-pipeline/black-marsh-mod-source) armoured daedroth re-material (decision 0030)
assetAvailability.notes: The Last Warden final boss build; already the chosen path.
